app.title: Sensory Overload Simulator
lang.en.name: English
lang.tl.name: Taglish
comfort.intro: In about 5 minutes, you'll ride a jeepney or walk through a mall while sounds, lights and crowds build up. Then you'll switch each one off and see what helps.
comfort.warnPhoto: This has flickering light effects, never more than 2 flashes per second. If flashing light affects you, keep gentle mode on: it removes all flicker.
comfort.warnSound: Headphones make it feel more real. Set your volume low first: sound starts quiet and gets louder. Every sound has a caption, so it also works with sound off.
comfort.stopNote: You can stop any time with the “Stop / I need a break” button, or by pressing Esc.
comfort.gentleDesc: Quieter sound, no flicker, no shaking, no movement.
comfort.gentleAuto: Turned on because your device is set to reduce motion.
comfort.startHint: Starting turns on sound at a low volume.
common.oneExample: This is one example. Every autistic person's senses work differently.

task.jeepney.prompt: Your fare is ₱{fare}. You pass a ₱{paid} bill forward. How much change should come back?
task.mall.prompt: Find the pharmacy. Tap its sign.
toggle.intro: Switch each one off. You'll see the real-life accommodation that does the same thing.
toggle.allOff: Everything is off. Same place — just easier to be in.
acc.smell: A calm space away from strong smells
jeepney.title: Jeepney ride
jeepney.alt: You're sitting on the side bench of a jeepney. Passengers sit across from you, and a busy street goes by through the windows. Signs and a rosary hang from the ceiling.
jeepney.desc.noise: Engine, horns, a barker calling routes, a loud radio
jeepney.desc.light: Sun glare and flicker through the windows
jeepney.desc.social: “Bayad po”: passing fares and counting change
jeepney.desc.sudden: A hard brake, a route change
cap.jeepney.barker: A barker shouting: “Cubao! Cubao! Sakay na!”
cap.jeepney.coins: Coins clinking as fares are passed
cap.jeepney.brake: Hard brake! The driver swerves onto a different route.
cue.jeepney.smell1: Diesel exhaust drifts in through the window.
cue.jeepney.touch1: The passenger across from you presses their knees against yours.
cue.jeepney.touch2: Someone squeezes in. Your arm is pinned.
cue.jeepney.speech1: “Bayad po!” Someone hands you coins to pass forward.
cue.jeepney.speech2: “Sukli po?” They're waiting for their change.
mall.title: Mall trip
mall.alt: A mall corridor with shopfronts, bright LED signs, rows of ceiling lights, an escalator and a crowd of shoppers.
mall.desc.noise: Background music, PA announcements, crowd chatter
mall.desc.crowding: Shoulder bumps in a crowded corridor
mall.desc.social: A salesperson talking fast and asking questions
mall.desc.sudden: An alarm or a sudden announcement
cap.mall.alarm: A sudden alarm beeps, then an announcement cuts in.
cue.mall.smell1: Food court: fried chicken and garlic rice.
cue.mall.smell2: A perfume counter sprays as you pass.
cue.mall.speech1: Salesperson: “Hi! Want to try this? What size? Cash or card?”
cue.mall.speech2: Salesperson: “Sale today only! Want to see more? Need a bag?”
break.body: Everything is quiet now. Take as long as you need.
break.tooMuch: TODO (advisor review): short “if this felt like too much” note, e.g. a breathing tip or where to talk to someone.
